2609.31047.title: DynBranch: Speculative Subgraph Reuse for Dynamic Agentic LLM Serving
2609.31047.paper_summary: Agentic LLM workflows decide their execution paths at runtime. Downstream computation may be predictable, or may have run before, yet it cannot begin until the model or the user resolves the branch. We call this serialization the branch-resolution barrier. Caching alone does not hide it: the key that identifies a reusable result is not known until then. In this paper, we propose DynBranch, which makes an unresolved branch addressable before it resolves. Its stable coordinate lets candidate subgraphs run during resolution and completed subgraph results be reused across later requests. A two-level controller admits this work when its expected benefit exceeds the load price. DynBranch sits at the model-API boundary and requires no changes to agent harnesses or model execution engines. Across four agentic workloads with Qwen3-32B on 4x H200 GPUs, DynBranch reduces mean latency by up to 32% over each workload's strongest prior system and by 46-66% against a no-reuse floor, while preserving workflow results. The benefit persists across backbone families and on a commodity Qwen3-8B/RTX 4090 deployment.
2609.31047.paper_summary_zh: 代理型 LLM 工作流程在運行時決定其執行路徑。下游計算可能是可預測的，或者可能已經運行過，但在模型或用戶解決分支之前，它無法開始。我們稱這種序列化為分支解析障礙。僅僅依賴快取並不能隱藏它：識別可重用結果的鍵在那之前是未知的。在本文中，我們提出了 DynBranch，它使未解析的分支在解析之前變得可尋址。它的穩定坐標允許候選子圖在解析期間運行，並使完成的子圖結果能在後續請求中重用。當預期收益超過負載成本時，二級控制器會接受這項工作。DynBranch 位於模型-API 邊界，並且不需要對代理工具或模型執行引擎進行任何更改。在四個使用 Qwen3-32B 的代理型工作負載上，DynBranch 在每個工作負載的最強先前系統上將平均延遲降低了多達 32%，並在沒有重用的基準上降低了 46-66%，同時保留工作流程結果。這一好處在各個主幹系列和商用 Qwen3-8B/RTX 4090 部署中持續存在。
